public_requirements: GET /sessions/:sid/skills lists the gated-review shortcuts only for a session that is given the gated-review server: OAKRIDGE_GATED_REVIEW_URL is set and the session's workflow identity carries a gated-review grant.
For any other session, a gated-review shortcut behaves as an unknown or hidden skill: invoking it answers 404 and submits nothing.
The decision depends only on whether a grant is present: every grant kind and role gets the same shortcuts.
Fixture mode is unchanged: config.skills.fixtures still lists and invokes the fixture skills for every session.
